desc: Mumbai Harbour is a natural deep-water harbour on the western coast of India, forming one of the finest natural harbours in Asia. It encompasses Mumbai Port, Jawaharlal Nehru Port, and numerous docks and terminals. The harbour is protected by the Konkan coast and the island of Mumbai, providing shelter from the Arabian Sea. It has been a major maritime gateway for over 2,000 years, serving as a key center for trade and commerce. The harbour features extensive shipbuilding, repair facilities, and container terminals. The Mumbai Harbour is also a strategic base for the Indian Navy's Western Command with INS Shikra and other naval installations.
fact: It is one of the finest natural deep-water harbours in Asia · It encompasses Mumbai Port and Jawaharlal Nehru Port · It has been a major maritime gateway for over 2,000 years · It serves as a strategic base for the Indian Navy's Western Command

desc: Kochi Harbour is a natural harbour located on the Malabar Coast of Kerala, formed by the Vembanad Lake lagoon system. It is one of the finest natural harbours on the Arabian Sea, protected by the Willingdon Island and the surrounding peninsulas. The harbour has been a center of the spice trade for centuries, attracting Phoenician, Roman, Arab, Chinese, and European traders. It is home to Cochin Port, the International Container Transshipment Terminal at Vallarpadam, and the Southern Naval Command headquarters of the Indian Navy. The harbour is known for its scenic backwaters and Chinese fishing nets.
fact: It is a natural harbour on the Malabar Coast formed by the Vembanad Lake lagoon · It has been a center of the spice trade since ancient times · It hosts the International Container Transshipment Terminal at Vallarpadam · The harbour is known for Chinese fishing nets and scenic backwaters

desc: Visakhapatnam Harbour is a protected natural harbour on the east coast of India, situated between the Yarada Hills and the Dolphin's Nose hill. It is one of the deepest harbours on the eastern coast with depths reaching 17 meters. The harbour is protected by a natural breakwater formed by the Dolphin's Nose hill and man-made breakwaters. It houses the Visakhapatnam Port, India's second-largest port by cargo volume, and the Eastern Naval Command headquarters of the Indian Navy, the largest naval command in India. The Inner Harbour handles general cargo while the Outer Harbour handles deep-draft bulk carriers.
fact: It is one of the deepest harbours on India's east coast with depths up to 17 meters · It is protected by the Yarada Hills and Dolphin's Nose hill · It houses the Eastern Naval Command, the largest Indian Navy command · The harbour has both inner and outer sections for different vessel types

desc: Chennai Harbour is an artificial harbour built on the Coromandel Coast of Tamil Nadu, created by extensive breakwaters and dredging. Constructed in 1881, it is one of the oldest artificial harbours on the eastern coast of India. The harbour is protected by two large breakwaters extending into the Bay of Bengal, creating a safe anchorage in an otherwise open and surf-beaten coast. It hosts Chennai Port, India's second-largest container port, with extensive facilities for container, bulk, and automobile cargo. The harbour is known for handling a significant volume of automobile exports, earning it the title 'Detroit of India' gateway.
fact: Chennai Harbour is an artificial harbour built in 1881 on the Coromandel Coast · It is created by large breakwaters in an otherwise open and surf-beaten coast · It handles the highest volume of automobile exports among Indian ports · It hosts Chennai Port, India's second-largest container port

desc: Porbandar Harbour is a natural harbour located on the Saurashtra coast of Gujarat, at the mouth of the Rupen River. It is famous as the birthplace of Mahatma Gandhi and has been a significant port for maritime trade with East Africa and the Middle East for centuries. The harbour is protected by the Porbandar creek and is known for its whale and dolphin watching opportunities. The harbour now serves as a fishing port and handles small cargo vessels. The Sudama Temple, an ancient shrine dedicated to Lord Krishna, overlooks the harbour.
fact: Porbandar is the birthplace of Mahatma Gandhi and a historic Saurashtra port · It has had maritime trade links with East Africa and the Middle East for centuries · The harbour is known for whale and dolphin watching · The ancient Sudama Temple overlooks the harbour
